description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) rebuilt as a dedicated list + form page matching the wireframe: Header, auto-calculated Quantity Summary, a multi-row item grid with received/accepted/rejected split and live available-stock lookup, and an Other Details sign-off block. Saving the record completes the GRN and receives the accepted quantity into stock — there is no approval workflow.
api_endpoints: GET /stock?itemId=&locationId= (available qty for the line grid)
schema_changes: txn_header_mst.txh_prepared_by_emp_id_emp added (integer, FK hrc_employee_mst) — the table already had txh_prepared_date but no matching person column
behaviour_changes: initialSubmitStatus no longer routes GRN to Pending Approval — a submitted GRN goes straight to Completed, matching the wireframe's 'no approval workflow involved'.
postsStockOnSubmit now includes GRN, so the accepted quantity is received into inv_stock_mst on save. Rejected quantity is deliberately not stocked (resolveQty prefers acceptedQty for GRN).
Approved By / Approved Date are recorded sign-off fields on the document, not a workflow gate.
notes: Only Draft GRNs are editable; once Completed the quantities are already in stock so the backend rejects updates. Accepted + Rejected must equal Received on every line (validated client-side and highlighted in the grid). Line Amount defaults to the item's standard cost x received qty and stays editable; items with a null standard cost leave it blank for manual entry. Item lines were refactored onto a shared lineGrid module (stable functional patching so async stock lookups cannot overwrite a newer item selection) and shared txnLookups quick-add configs, both now used by Store Requisition as well. Verified end to end by backend/verify-grn.ps1 (47 checks).
